name: Harmonies
variant: base (Personal board side A or B)

categories.label: Trees
categories.hint: Count trees by height: green on 0 brown = 1, on 1 brown = 3, on 2 brown = 7. Brown-only stacks score 0.

categories.label: Mountains (adjacent to another mountain)
categories.hint: Gray stacks adjacent to another mountain: height 1 = 1, height 2 = 3, height 3 = 7. Isolated mountain = 0.

categories.label: Fields
categories.hint: Each contiguous group of 2+ yellow tokens = 5 points (size doesn't matter).

categories.label: Buildings
categories.hint: 5 points per building (red on top of brown/grey/red) with top tokens of at least 3 different colours around it, else 0.

categories.label: Water - River (side A)
categories.hint: Length of best river by shortest path. 1:0, 2:2, 3:5, 4:8, 5:11, 6:15, +4 per token beyond 6. Skip if playing side B.

categories.label: Water - Islands (side B)
categories.hint: 5 points per island; you always have at least 1. Skip if playing side A.

categories.label: Animal cards
categories.hint: Per card (completed or not): value of the topmost space not covered by a cube; a card with all cubes still on it = 0.

categories.label: Nature's Spirit card
categories.hint: Only if used and its cube was placed; value per card text, in addition to normal landscape points.

categories.label: Animal cubes placed on board (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số khối động vật đã đặt (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Most Animal cubes placed on the Personal board
If still tied, players share the victory.

notes: family: end-game-categories. Game ends when the pouch cannot refill the Central board or a player ends their turn with 2 or fewer empty spaces; finish the round so turns are equal. Tree, mountain and river point values verified visually in the official rulebook p.8 (Tallying Points); river: 1:0, 2:2, 3:5, 4:8, 5:11, 6:15, +4 per token beyond 6 (table capped at 14 tokens). Nature's Spirit cards (optional) vary per card; their points are scored like Animal cards, in addition to all others. Pokemon Harmonies and solo mode not modelled.

sources.title: Harmonies Game Rules (Libellud)
sources.section: p.7 End of Game and tiebreak; p.8 Tallying Points (trees, mountains, fields, buildings, river, islands, animal cards); Nature's Spirit cards
